source.sql: WITH CAL AS (SELECT TO_DATE(GENERATED_PERIOD_START) AS PERIOD_START FROM SERIES_GENERATE_TIMESTAMP('INTERVAL 1 MONTH','2023-01-01','2026-01-01')), MV AS (SELECT MATERIAL_ID, POSTING_DATE, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QUANTITY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT_PART_001 WHERE PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND MOVEMENT_TYPE IN ('261','262') UNION ALL SELECT MATERIAL_ID, POSTING_DATE, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QUANTITY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT_PART_002 WHERE PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND MOVEMENT_TYPE IN ('261','262') UNION ALL SELECT MATERIAL_ID, POSTING_DATE, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QUANTITY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT_PART_003 WHERE PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND MOVEMENT_TYPE IN ('261','262') UNION ALL SELECT MATERIAL_ID, POSTING_DATE, MOVEMENT_TYPE, QUANTITY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_MATERIAL_MOVEMENT_PART_004 WHERE PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND MOVEMENT_TYPE IN ('261','262')), MON AS (SELECT MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(POSTING_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(POSTING_DATE)) AS PERIOD_START, SUM(CASE WHEN MOVEMENT_TYPE='261' THEN QUANTITY ELSE -QUANTITY END) AS NET_QTY FROM MV GROUP BY MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(POSTING_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(POSTING_DATE))), SER AS (SELECT DISTINCT V.MATERIAL_ID, M.MATERIAL_GROUP, M.MATERIAL_TYPE FROM MV V JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MATERIAL M ON M.MATERIAL_ID=V.MATERIAL_ID WHERE M.MATERIAL_TYPE IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN')), MNT AS (SELECT R.MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(O.PLANNED_START_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(O.PLANNED_START_DATE)) AS PERIOD_START, SUM(R.REQUIRED_QTY) AS QTY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_MAINTENANCE_REQUIREMENT R JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_MAINTENANCE_ORDER O ON O.MAINTENANCE_ORDER_ID=R.MAINTENANCE_ORDER_ID JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_EQUIPMENT E ON E.EQUIPMENT_ID=O.EQUIPMENT_ID WHERE E.PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' GROUP BY R.MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(O.PLANNED_START_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(O.PLANNED_START_DATE))), SDQ AS (SELECT S.MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(E.PLANNED_START_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(E.PLANNED_START_DATE)) AS PERIOD_START, SUM(S.REQUIRED_QTY) AS QTY FROM VEDANTA_POC.FACT_SHUTDOWN_SCHEDULE S JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_SHUTDOWN_EVENT E ON E.SHUTDOWN_ID=S.SHUTDOWN_ID WHERE E.PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' GROUP BY S.MATERIAL_ID, ADD_DAYS(E.PLANNED_START_DATE, 1-DAYOFMONTH(E.PLANNED_START_DATE))), SDM AS (SELECT DISTINCT C.PERIOD_START FROM CAL C JOIN VEDANTA_POC.DIM_SHUTDOWN_EVENT E ON E.PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND E.PLANNED_START_DATE<=LAST_DAY(C.PERIOD_START) AND E.PLANNED_END_DATE>=C.PERIOD_START) SELECT S.MATERIAL_ID || '|HZL_DEMO_01' AS SERIES_ID, S.MATERIAL_ID, 'HZL_DEMO_01' AS PLANT_ID, S.MATERIAL_GROUP, S.MATERIAL_TYPE, TO_VARCHAR(C.PERIOD_START,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PERIOD_START_DATE, COALESCE(MO.NET_QTY,0) AS NET_CONSUMPTION_QTY, COALESCE(MN.QTY,0) AS PLANNED_MAINTENANCE_QTY, COALESCE(SQ.QTY,0) AS PLANNED_SHUTDOWN_QTY, CASE WHEN SM.PERIOD_START IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PLANT_SHUTDOWN_MONTH_FLAG, COALESCE(SI.MANUAL_OVERRIDE_INDEX, SI.SEASON_INDEX_DERIVED) AS SEASON_INDEX, MONTH(C.PERIOD_START) AS MONTH_OF_YEAR FROM SER S CROSS JOIN CAL C LEFT JOIN MON MO ON MO.MATERIAL_ID=S.MATERIAL_ID AND MO.PERIOD_START=C.PERIOD_START LEFT JOIN MNT MN ON MN.MATERIAL_ID=S.MATERIAL_ID AND MN.PERIOD_START=C.PERIOD_START LEFT JOIN SDQ SQ ON SQ.MATERIAL_ID=S.MATERIAL_ID AND SQ.PERIOD_START=C.PERIOD_START LEFT JOIN SDM SM ON SM.PERIOD_START=C.PERIOD_START LEFT JOIN VEDANTA_POC.SEASONALITY_INPUT SI ON SI.PLANT_ID='HZL_DEMO_01' AND SI.MATERIAL_GROUP=S.MATERIAL_GROUP AND SI.CALENDAR_MONTH_NO=MONTH(C.PERIOD_START) ORDER BY SERIES_ID, PERIOD_START_DATE
